prompt_text: I need a dental implant in Chicago. Which specific dental practices should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Chicago for a dental implant?
competitors_mentioned: American Academy of Implant Dentistry. These
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I’ll give you a tailored list of specific practices to call, but first I need two quick things so the recommendations fit you:

1) Where in Chicago (zip code or neighborhood) will be most convenient?  
2) Is this for a single tooth, multiple teeth, or a full-arch (All‑on‑4) restoration? Also tell me if you have major constraints (insurance plan, budget, need for sedation, preference for a periodontist vs oral surgeon).

If you want a quick actionable start now, here’s what I recommend calling right away and what to ask — even before I build a neighborhood-specific list.

Places to call (good initial options)
- University clinic: University of Illinois at Chicago (UIC) College of Dentistry — teaching clinic. Pros: supervised by experienced faculty, often lower fees, handles complex cases and referrals. Good if budget or complex grafting/sinus lifts may be needed.
- Hospital/academic oral surgery department: Call any oral & maxillofacial surgery department at a major hospital near you if you have medical complexity or need IV sedation/general anesthesia.
- Local board-certified specialists: call a periodontist or oral surgeon in your neighborhood who lists “dental implants” on their site and is a member of AAOMS, AAP (periodontology), or the American Academy of Implant Dentistry. These specialists routinely place implants and manage grafts/sinus lifts.
- Restorative/implant-focused private practice: look for practices advertising full-service implant care (placement + restoration) or a team approach (surgeon + prosthodontist). This reduces coordination errors and unexpected costs.

What to ask when you call (phone script)
- Do you place implants, or do you refer out for placement? Who will do the restoration?
- Do you use CBCT (3D) imaging before surgery?
- What implant system/brand do you use?
- Do you provide a full written estimate? Is the crown/abutment included or separate?
- Do you perform bone grafting or sinus lifts if needed?
- What sedation options are available (local, oral sedation, IV)?
- Length of the treatment timeline from implant placement to final crown?
- Warranty/guarantee and follow-up care?
- Do you accept my insurance or offer financing?

How I’ll proceed once you tell me your neighborhood and needs
- I’ll give 5–8 specific practices near you (names, brief reason to call each — e.g., expert in full-arch, oral surgeon with sedation, teaching clinic with lower fees, prosthodontist for complex esthetic restorations).
- I’ll flag any top-reviewed specialists with appropriate board memberships and links to verify credentials.
- I’ll include a short comparison (approx. cost ranges, typical wait time, whether they do single implants vs full-arch).

Tell me your zip code or neighborhood and whether this is a single implant or larger restoration, and I’ll prepare that specific list.
